meta.note: Built from the chosen Studio boards (Lens, Map, side rail, overlays, signals). Dark values are the boards' exact values; Light and the two high-contrast themes are new and measured.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The page itself, behind everything. Text tokens are measured on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels that sit on the ground: dialogs, popovers, toasts, the palette, the widened side rail. In dark it is a shade above ground; in light it is white paper.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: A second step up: the list row being hovered, a code block, a picked option's well, a meter's track.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The dim laid over the page behind a dialog, the palette or the widened side rail. Decorative: the dialog itself carries the meaning.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Titles, numbers and anything that must read first, on ground, surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and button labels on ground, surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Section labels (the spaced capitals of a zone heading) on ground, surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: notes, facts under a name, the 'why' line under a dialog title. On ground, surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: subtle
tokens.usage: Commands (`$ loadout …`), placeholders and timestamps. Still 4.5:1 or better (7:1 in high contrast) on every ground, because a command is read, not decoration.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines that only group things: the line after a zone heading, list separators. Decorative in dark and light; 3:1 or better in the high-contrast themes, where surfaces are set apart by borders.

tokens.name: control-edge
tokens.usage: The edge of a control that has no fill: an input, a toggle track, a segmented control. 3:1 or better on every ground in every theme.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring: a solid 2px outline, 2–4px off the control. 3:1 or better on every ground. White in dark, near-black in light, yellow and blue in high contrast.

tokens.name: moving
tokens.usage: Signal family Moving (working, running, doing, round running): the state glyph's ring, the orbiter, the meter fill. Also readable as text on every ground.

tokens.name: needs
tokens.usage: Signal family Needs (needs a decision, waiting for you): the glyph ring, the glow on whatever is waiting, an amber halo button. As text on every ground too.

tokens.name: needs-text
tokens.usage: Text that belongs to a Needs item: the question asked, the age of the wait. On ground, surface, surface-2 and needs-wash.

tokens.name: needs-wash
tokens.usage: The faint fill behind a card or toast that needs you. Never the only signal: the word, glyph and needs edge come with it.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Signal family Bad (failed, last round failed, blocked, limited): glyph ring and edge. As text on every ground too.

tokens.name: bad-text
tokens.usage: Text inside a problem toast or card. On ground, surface, surface-2 and bad-wash.

tokens.name: bad-wash
tokens.usage: The faint fill behind a problem toast or card, always with the word, the glyph and the bad edge.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Signal family Good (done, met, accepted). Done and failed differ by glyph and word, never by this colour alone.

tokens.name: rest
tokens.usage: Signal family Rest (idle, open, captured, shaping, held, stopped, not attempted, unknown, dropped).

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text or a glyph drawn on a solid signal fill (the small glyph discs in the Ambient signal strip). 4.5:1 or better on all five families (7:1 in high contrast).

tokens.name: gauge
tokens.usage: The Gyroscope halo's spend ring and its legend dot. Always labelled 'Spend'; never a status.

tokens.name: shaping
tokens.usage: The Lens halo's Shaping ring and its mark. A stage colour on the halo only; as a state, shaping belongs to the Rest family. 3:1 or better on every ground.

tokens.name: line-1
tokens.usage: Map line 1's identity colour: its track, stops, badge and train. Identity, never state: a line keeps its colour from Captured to Done, and state is its Signal. 3:1 or better on every ground.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Map line 2's identity colour: its track, stops, badge and train. Identity, never state: a line keeps its colour from Captured to Done, and state is its Signal. 3:1 or better on every ground.

tokens.name: line-3
tokens.usage: Map line 3's identity colour: its track, stops, badge and train. Identity, never state: a line keeps its colour from Captured to Done, and state is its Signal. 3:1 or better on every ground.

tokens.name: line-4
tokens.usage: Map line 4's identity colour: its track, stops, badge and train. Identity, never state: a line keeps its colour from Captured to Done, and state is its Signal. 3:1 or better on every ground.

tokens.name: line-5
tokens.usage: Map line 5's identity colour: its track, stops, badge and train. Identity, never state: a line keeps its colour from Captured to Done, and state is its Signal. 3:1 or better on every ground.

tokens.name: line-6
tokens.usage: Map line 6's identity colour: its track, stops, badge and train. Identity, never state: a line keeps its colour from Captured to Done, and state is its Signal. 3:1 or better on every ground.

tokens.name: line-7
tokens.usage: Map line 7's identity colour: its track, stops, badge and train. Identity, never state: a line keeps its colour from Captured to Done, and state is its Signal. 3:1 or better on every ground.

tokens.name: line-8
tokens.usage: Map line 8's identity colour: its track, stops, badge and train. Identity, never state: a line keeps its colour from Captured to Done, and state is its Signal. 3:1 or better on every ground.

tokens.name: on-line
tokens.usage: The number on a train and on a line badge, on any line colour. 4.5:1 or better on all eight (7:1 in high contrast).

tokens.name: term-bg
tokens.usage: The terminal's ground. The same as `surface` in Dark and Light, and `ground` in high contrast, so the terminal sits in Studio rather than on a slab of its own.

tokens.name: term-fg
tokens.usage: Default terminal text. 4.5:1 or better on term-bg and term-selection (7:1 in high contrast).

tokens.name: term-selection
tokens.usage: Selected text's background. Every terminal text colour stays 4.5:1 or better on it (7:1 in high contrast).

tokens.name: term-black
tokens.usage: ANSI black. In Dark and High contrast dark it is a background (term-fg reads on it); in the light themes it is text. Text colours are 4.5:1 or better on term-bg and term-selection (7:1 in high contrast).

tokens.name: term-red
tokens.usage: ANSI red: errors and removed lines. The same hue as `bad`. Text colours are 4.5:1 or better on term-bg and term-selection (7:1 in high contrast).

tokens.name: term-green
tokens.usage: ANSI green: success and added lines. The same hue as `good`. Text colours are 4.5:1 or better on term-bg and term-selection (7:1 in high contrast).

tokens.name: term-yellow
tokens.usage: ANSI yellow: warnings. The same hue as `needs`. Text colours are 4.5:1 or better on term-bg and term-selection (7:1 in high contrast).

tokens.name: term-blue
tokens.usage: ANSI blue: paths and links. The same hue as `moving`. Text colours are 4.5:1 or better on term-bg and term-selection (7:1 in high contrast).

tokens.name: term-magenta
tokens.usage: ANSI magenta. The same hue as `shaping`. Text colours are 4.5:1 or better on term-bg and term-selection (7:1 in high contrast).

tokens.name: term-cyan
tokens.usage: ANSI cyan. Studio's cyan, fixed: it does not follow the accent, because agents use it as a colour, not as Studio's accent. Text colours are 4.5:1 or better on term-bg and term-selection (7:1 in high contrast).

tokens.name: term-white
tokens.usage: ANSI white. In the light themes a dark grey, so it reads on white. Text colours are 4.5:1 or better on term-bg and term-selection (7:1 in high contrast).

tokens.name: term-bright-black
tokens.usage: ANSI bright black, the bold or emphasised form of term-black. 4.5:1 or better on term-bg and term-selection (7:1 in high contrast).

tokens.name: term-bright-red
tokens.usage: ANSI bright red, the bold or emphasised form of term-red. 4.5:1 or better on term-bg and term-selection (7:1 in high contrast).

tokens.name: term-bright-green
tokens.usage: ANSI bright green, the bold or emphasised form of term-green. 4.5:1 or better on term-bg and term-selection (7:1 in high contrast).

tokens.name: term-bright-yellow
tokens.usage: ANSI bright yellow, the bold or emphasised form of term-yellow. 4.5:1 or better on term-bg and term-selection (7:1 in high contrast).

tokens.name: term-bright-blue
tokens.usage: ANSI bright blue, the bold or emphasised form of term-blue. 4.5:1 or better on term-bg and term-selection (7:1 in high contrast).

tokens.name: term-bright-magenta
tokens.usage: ANSI bright magenta, the bold or emphasised form of term-magenta. 4.5:1 or better on term-bg and term-selection (7:1 in high contrast).

tokens.name: term-bright-cyan
tokens.usage: ANSI bright cyan, the bold or emphasised form of term-cyan. 4.5:1 or better on term-bg and term-selection (7:1 in high contrast).

tokens.name: term-bright-white
tokens.usage: ANSI bright white, the bold or emphasised form of term-white. 4.5:1 or better on term-bg and term-selection (7:1 in high contrast).

tokens.name: accent-cyan
tokens.usage: Cyan accent fill: halo rings, the tab fill, the current page's bar, the line after a zone heading. 3:1 or better on every ground. Read through `accent`, never directly.

tokens.name: accent-cyan-text
tokens.usage: Cyan accent as text: zone numbers, links, the caret. 4.5:1 or better (7:1 in high contrast) on ground, surface and surface-2. Read through `accent-text`.

tokens.name: on-accent-cyan
tokens.usage: Text on a solid Cyan accent fill (the WHAT SHOULD IT DO? tab). 4.5:1 or better (7:1 in high contrast). Read through `on-accent`.

tokens.name: accent-ice
tokens.usage: Ice accent fill: halo rings, the tab fill, the current page's bar, the line after a zone heading. 3:1 or better on every ground. Read through `accent`, never directly.

tokens.name: accent-ice-text
tokens.usage: Ice accent as text: zone numbers, links, the caret. 4.5:1 or better (7:1 in high contrast) on ground, surface and surface-2. Read through `accent-text`.

tokens.name: on-accent-ice
tokens.usage: Text on a solid Ice accent fill (the WHAT SHOULD IT DO? tab). 4.5:1 or better (7:1 in high contrast). Read through `on-accent`.

tokens.name: accent-magenta
tokens.usage: Magenta accent fill: halo rings, the tab fill, the current page's bar, the line after a zone heading. 3:1 or better on every ground. Read through `accent`, never directly.

tokens.name: accent-magenta-text
tokens.usage: Magenta accent as text: zone numbers, links, the caret. 4.5:1 or better (7:1 in high contrast) on ground, surface and surface-2. Read through `accent-text`.

tokens.name: on-accent-magenta
tokens.usage: Text on a solid Magenta accent fill (the WHAT SHOULD IT DO? tab). 4.5:1 or better (7:1 in high contrast). Read through `on-accent`.

tokens.name: accent-violet
tokens.usage: Violet accent fill: halo rings, the tab fill, the current page's bar, the line after a zone heading. 3:1 or better on every ground. Read through `accent`, never directly.

tokens.name: accent-violet-text
tokens.usage: Violet accent as text: zone numbers, links, the caret. 4.5:1 or better (7:1 in high contrast) on ground, surface and surface-2. Read through `accent-text`.

tokens.name: on-accent-violet
tokens.usage: Text on a solid Violet accent fill (the WHAT SHOULD IT DO? tab). 4.5:1 or better (7:1 in high contrast). Read through `on-accent`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The accent in use. Cyan unless the person picks Ice, Magenta or Violet (`data-accent` on <html>, which rebinds this to accent-<name>). Rings, strokes, tab fills and every accent glow read it. The accent never means a state: state is the five signal families.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: The accent in use, as text. Rebinds with `data-accent`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `accent` fill. Rebinds with `data-accent`.

tokens.name: term-cursor
tokens.usage: The terminal's cursor: the accent in use, a block when the terminal has focus and an outline when it doesn't. The character under a block cursor is drawn in term-bg.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Big numbers: a toggle's state in Halo controls, a dialog's result count.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: A page title and the Ambient corner numbers. Thin on purpose: the glow carries weight in dark; in light and high contrast the ink does.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The thing in focus on Lens, a dialog's title.

styles.name: ask
styles.sample: Push the tag v0.66.0 to origin?
styles.usage: A question waiting for you, where it is answered.

styles.name: entry
styles.sample: why is this postgres query so slow
styles.usage: Text typed into the start-a-session rail.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body copy, list titles, toast text.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Everything you start shows the command it runs.
styles.usage: The 'why' line under a heading, legends, options.

styles.name: label-zone
styles.usage: Zone headings: spaced capitals, ink-soft, followed by an accent hairline.

styles.name: label-tab
styles.usage: The accent tab over the start rail, field labels, tab buttons.

styles.name: label-nav
styles.usage: Side-rail page names and the Lens/Map switch.

styles.name: cmd
styles.usage: The command beside or under every action that changes something.

styles.name: mono-meta
styles.usage: Times, ages and counts in feeds and meters.

styles.name: mono-note
styles.usage: Live counts under a page name in the rail, units on a meter.

spacing.note: One scale, multiplied by the density in use: Compact 0.8, Comfortable 1 (the default), Roomy 1.25. Components read calc(var(--space-n) * var(--density)).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a glyph and its word inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a title and the facts under it; between stacked toasts.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a halo ring and its label; inside a list row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The page's side gutter at 320px; padding inside a popover.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding inside a toast and a palette row.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: The start rail's left padding; padding inside a dialog.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between a zone and the next; the page's side gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above a page's first zone; around the Lens halo.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: The side rail, collapsed. Pages start this far in. Not multiplied by density.

tokens.name: rail-width-open
tokens.usage: The side rail, widened; it slides over the page, it never pushes it.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small halo buttons and chips. Never below 24px at any density (WCAG 2.2 target size).

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Halo buttons, list rows, toggles.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: The start-a-session rail.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Panels, rails, the start rail, toasts, tabs: Studio is square. Shapes are carried by light, not corners.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Signal marks and the small chips on a meter.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Meter tracks and fills, the Lens/Map count pills.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Halo rings, glyph discs, orbiters: anything that is a ring.

density.note: Set with data-density on <html>: compact, comfortable (default) or roomy.

tokens.name: density-compact
tokens.usage: Compact: more on the screen, for big monitors.

tokens.name: density-comfortable
tokens.usage: Comfortable: the boards as designed.

tokens.name: density-roomy
tokens.usage: Roomy: for touch, zoom and low vision.

glow.note: Glow is light from the accent or a signal colour. It is on in Dark and off in Light and both high-contrast themes, where strokes and borders do the same job.

tokens.name: glow-sm
tokens.usage: Blur of the glow on a glyph disc or the dot in a halo ring.

tokens.name: glow-md
tokens.usage: Blur of the glow round a halo ring and on a zone number.

tokens.name: glow-lg
tokens.usage: Blur of the glow on a hovered or focused halo ring, and the settle flash when something finishes.

tokens.name: glow-strength
tokens.usage: How much of the colour a glow carries in Dark.

tokens.name: tint-hover
tokens.usage: Accent mixed into the ground under a hovered row.

tokens.name: tint-picked
tokens.usage: Accent mixed into the ground at the start of a picked row's fade.

tokens.name: tint-line
tokens.usage: Accent mixed into a decorative hairline (the line after a zone heading).

duration.note: Motion is set to full, reduced or none in Settings, and the operating system's reduced-motion preference always wins. Under reduced, things fade instead of travelling and nothing loops; under none, nothing animates.

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Colour and text changes on hover.

tokens.name: dur-quick
tokens.usage: Row backgrounds, the rail widening.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: A halo ring growing on hover, panels projecting in.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: A tether unfolding, the dim fading in.

tokens.name: dur-travel
tokens.usage: The Lens focus turning to a new item; a train between stops.

tokens.name: dur-breathe
tokens.usage: One breath of a Moving glyph. Loops only under full motion.

tokens.name: dur-toast-fold
tokens.usage: How long a toast stays open before folding to its small form.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Almost everything: quick out, long settle.

tokens.name: ease-travel
tokens.usage: Travel along a path: a train, the focus turning.

tokens.name: recede
tokens.usage: What is less urgent recedes to this when something needs you, and an idle signal dims to it. Dark only: text there stays 4.5:1 or better. In Light and both high-contrast themes nothing fades (a fade would break contrast), so the rise alone carries urgency.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Lifts what floats over the page (toasts, popovers, dialogs, the palette) off it. A soft dark shadow in Dark and Light; none in high contrast, where a 2px edge does the job.

tokens.name: z-ground
tokens.usage: Behind the page: the field map (FieldMap), which shows only where the page shows its ground.

tokens.name: z-page
tokens.usage: Things that float over the page itself but belong to it: a popover from a picker, the Next chip, a command line's suggestions.

tokens.name: z-rail
tokens.usage: The side rail at rest, and the Pages tab below 600px.

tokens.name: z-modebar
tokens.usage: The mode bar across the top.

tokens.name: z-focus
tokens.usage: Focus view, which starts below the mode bar and beside the rail.

tokens.name: z-rail-open
tokens.usage: The rail while it is widened, and the Pages slide-in with its dim. It draws over the mode bar and Focus view, which its dim covers like the rest of the page.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: A menu opened from something on the page, such as a terminal tab's menu.

tokens.name: z-scrim
tokens.usage: The dim behind a dialog.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: A dialog, over its dim and over an open rail.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, over everything a person works in, dialogs included.

tokens.name: z-skip
tokens.usage: The skip link, when it has focus.

tokens.name: z-ambient
tokens.usage: Ambient view, which covers the whole screen.
